name: CoT over TCP/TLS
description: Primary TAK Server connection for Cursor-on-Target event exchange using TCP with optional TLS encryption.

name: CoT over UDP multicast
description: Situational awareness broadcast using UDP multicast to 239.2.3.1:6969 for local network CoT sharing.

name: CoT over UDP unicast
description: Point-to-point CoT event exchange over UDP unicast for direct device communication.

name: HTTP/HTTPS REST API
description: TAK Server Mission API providing RESTful endpoints for mission data, user management, and server configuration.

name: Mission Package transfer
description: Transfer of mission packages as ZIP archives over HTTP, containing maps, overlays, routes, and other mission data.

name: KML/KMZ import/export
description: Import and export of geographic data using Keyhole Markup Language files and compressed KMZ archives.

name: GeoPackage/SpatiaLite
description: OGC GeoPackage and SpatiaLite database files for offline geospatial data storage and exchange.

name: WMS/WMTS tile services
description: Web Map Service and Web Map Tile Service connections for streaming raster map imagery from tile servers.

name: ATAK Plugin API
description: Android plugin interface using Intents and BroadcastReceivers for third-party ATAK plugin integration.

name: Repository dispatch / CI webhooks
description: GitHub repository dispatch events and CI webhook triggers for automated build and release pipelines.
